item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame

turns.text: Can you make this fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text.

item.tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.
answer_sheet.Filling extra space: A blurred copy of the same photo behind the intact portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

must_haves: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

turns.text: Can you make this pic fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—this needs **padding, not cropping**, so all the hair and shoulders visible in your original stay in frame, with a blurred duplicate filling the 9:16 background. No text.

**Nothing has been generated or charged.**

- **Cheapest Magic Hour option:** one image edit using the free-plan **Flux 2 Klein at 640px**, listed **from 5 credits per image**. I can’t verify an exact account-specific charge here, so that’s not a guaranteed quote. AI editing can also slightly change your appearance.
- **Best zero-credit option:** use a regular photo editor. Create a **1080 × 1920** canvas, enlarge a duplicate of the photo to fill it and blur it, then center the complete original on top. This preserves your photo without AI alterations.

For the AI route, 640px and one image are already the smallest, cheapest listed settings. “Shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image.

Would you prefer **free step-by-step instructions**, or proceed with the AI option at the listed starting cost of **5 credits**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the zero-credit option, with free step-by-step instructions. 360 × 640 is fine; keep all my hair and shoulders visible, with no text or retouching.

turns.agent:
Here’s the **zero-credit method** in any photo editor with layers and blur. No Magic Hour generation is needed.

1. **Create a 360 × 640 px canvas**—that’s a 9:16 story.
2. **Add your photo as the background layer.** Enlarge it proportionally until it fills the canvas. Cropping this background copy is fine.
3. **Blur that background copy** until its details look soft.
4. **Add the original photo again as a new layer on top.**
5. Set the top photo to **360 × 360 px**, keeping its proportions locked. Center it horizontally and vertically:
   - Left edge: **0 px**
   - Top edge: **140 px**
   
   This shows the entire original, preserving all the hair and shoulders visible in it, with blurred fill above and below.
6. Leave **filters, retouching, enhancements, borders, and text off**.
7. **Export at 360 × 640 px** as a high-quality JPG or PNG. Upload it to Instagram Stories without zooming in.

**Cost: 0 Magic Hour credits.** The smaller size works, though it will look softer than a standard 1080 × 1920 story.
